title: Ostenstraße, Karlsfeld
description:
Zimmer in ruhiger 3er-WG zu vermieten!

Von dem S-Bahnhof Karlsfeld sind es nur 20 min bis München Hauptbahnhof. 

Wir suchen eine/n neue/n Mitbewohner/in für unsere gemütliche 3-Personen-WG. Du suchst nach einer ruhigen Umgebung, in der du dich zurückziehen und entspannen kannst? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Das erwartet dich:

Dein Zimmer ist möbliert und mit einem Schreibtisch ausgestattet – ideal zum Arbeiten oder Lernen.

Schnelles WLAN und eine gemütliche Gemeinschaftsküche mit Essbereich, perfekt für entspannte Mahlzeiten.

Badezimmer mit Dusche, Badewanne und einer Waschmaschine.

Ein gemeinsamer Garten, den du mit uns genießen kannst – ob zum Entspannen oder zum Grillen.

Zusätzlich gibt es einen Trockenraum im Keller.

Die Wohnung befindet sich im obersten Geschoss, wodurch absolute Ruhe garantiert ist – ideal für alle, die eine ruhige Wohnatmosphäre schätzen.

Besonders attraktiv für Sportliebhaber: Auf Wunsch bieten wir vergünstigte CrossFit-Gym-Mitgliedschaften an.


Lage:

Direkt an einer Bushaltestelle gelegen, super Anbindung!

Nur 5 Minuten zu Fuß zum wunderschönen Karlsfelder See, einem 24 Hektar großen Naturparadies – perfekt zum Schwimmen, Spazieren oder einfach die Natur genießen.

In der Nähe des neuen Zentrums von Karlsfeld und dennoch in ruhiger Lage.

Karlsfeld liegt am nordwestlichen Stadtrand von München und bietet eine großartige Kombination aus Ruhe und Nähe zur Großstadt.

WG-Leben: Bei uns geht es ruhig und entspannt zu. Unsere WG ist perfekt für alle, die nach einem Rückzugsort suchen. Wer Action braucht, findet diese in unserer CrossFit-Box nur 5 km entfernt. Von gemeinsamen Sportausflügen, BBQs, Sauna-Abenden bis hin zu Ausflügen in München und Umgebung – bei uns ist immer etwas los, wenn man möchte. Alles ist optional, und deiner Kreativität sind keine Grenzen gesetzt!

ENGLISH:

Room available in a quiet 3-person shared flat!

From Sban Karlsfeld it's only 20 mins to Munich central station. 

We’re looking for a new tenant for our cozy 3-person shared flat. Are you someone who values peace and quiet in your living space? Then you’ve found the right place!

What we offer:

A fully furnished room with a desk – perfect for studying or working.

High-speed internet and a comfortable shared kitchen with a dining area for relaxed meals.

A bathroom with both a shower and a bathtub, plus a washing machine.

A shared garden where you can unwind, relax, or enjoy a BBQ with friends.

A drying room in (hidden)ment for your laundry.

Located on the top floor of the house, ensuring a peaceful and quiet atmosphere – ideal for those who seek tranquility.

Special perk: Reduced CrossFit gym membership available upon request for fitness enthusiasts.


Location:

Conveniently located right next to a bus stop.

From Sban Karlsfeld it's only 20 mins to the central station. 

Only a 5-minute walk to the beautiful Karlsfelder Lake, a 24-hectare natural lake – perfect for swimming, walking, or enjoying the outdoors.

Close to the new center in Karlsfeld, yet in a very quiet location.

Karlsfeld is a community on the northwestern outskirts of Munich, offering a perfect balance between peaceful living and proximity to the city.


Flatshare Lifestyle: Our home is a quiet, relaxed place. If you're looking for peace and quiet, this is the ideal environment. For those who want action, the CrossFit gym is only 5 km away. There, you can enjoy events, group sports activities, BBQs, sauna sessions, swimming, running, cycling, and more. We often explore Munich and the surrounding areas together, but everything is optional – the sky’s the limit for your creativity!

title: Lessingstraße, Karlsfeld
description:
Room Description
This cozy and modern private room offers a generous common area. The room is elegantly furnished with a comfortable bed, a large wardrobe, and a desk, providing ample space for both relaxation and productivity. Our shared apartments are the perfect opportunity for “newcomers” to Munich to quickly find their footing and build meaningful connections. Here, you’ll find not just a place to stay, but also a welcoming and vibrant community to be part of. Thanks to the relaxed and friendly atmosphere in our shared flats, settling in feels effortless. In our experience, everyone quickly finds their place—whether you’re new to the city or simply looking for a fresh start. We, as landlords, highly value respectful and considerate interactions among roommates—because a harmonious living environment is what truly makes shared living enjoyable!

Common Areas
The apartment was recently renovated and shines with a modern and fresh design. It features a stylish bathroom with high-quality, contemporary tiles that create a welcoming atmosphere. The built-in kitchen is fully equipped with everything needed for cooking and dining: a refrigerator, freezer, stovetop, oven, sink, dishwasher, and washing machine. Many of our shared apartments even include washing machines with an integrated dryer function, adding extra convenience. There is also a comfortable dining area with seating for shared meals and socializing. The high-quality flooring throughout the apartment enhances the modern ambiance and provides a comfortable living environment. Wi-Fi is, of course, available – either provided by the landlord and included in the monthly utility costs or organized among the flatmates, with minimal shared costs. This combination of comfort, style, and modern amenities makes living in this apartment particularly enjoyable and ensures a smooth daily routine.

Neighborhood
The apartment is located in a peaceful area of Munich. The neighborhood offers excellent public transportation options, making it easy to explore the city and access various local amenities. It combines a tranquil residential environment with close proximity to Munich’s vibrant cultural and social scenes, making it an ideal choice for both students and professionals seeking comfort and convenience.
 
Please note: The keys can only be handed over and you can only move in if the deposit has been demonstrably transferred to the provider before the move-in date. 
Payments and check-in details: 
- The deposit must be paid via the HousingAnywhere payment request or directly to the landlord via bank transfer before move-in; without this payment and proof of payment, we cannot check you in! 
- At the end of your stay, 30% of your deposit will be temporarily withheld to cover any outstanding utility costs. Since utility charges included in the rent are estimated in advance, the final bill may differ from the amount paid. Once the annual utility statement is available, any unused portion of the retained amount will be refunded.
- GEZ (Tv/Broadcasting tax, around €18.36 p/m) is not included in the rental price; this, along with the WiFi, is split and organized by Housemates already in the property. 
- Under German rental law, we are permitted to increase your rent by an annual rate of 2% per year. 
- Utility payments are an estimate; they can be slightly more or less than the amount paid. However, this is rare. You will be obligated to take out liability insurance when renting a room from us; this is fairly normal when renting a room in Germany. Please Google this to find more information.

title: Auf den Schrederwiesen, Munich
description:
Welcome to your home in Munich

This fully furnished townhouse offers a comfortable and practical home for professionals, relocating families, visiting academics and anyone looking for quality accommodation in Munich for an extended stay.

Located in the quiet residential district of Ludwigsfeld, the house provides approximately 118 m2 of living space with four bedrooms, two bathrooms, a guest WC, a bright open-plan living and dining area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a heated basement that can be used as additional living or workspace.

The townhouse accommodates up to 10 guests and includes reliable high-speed Wi-Fi, underground parking, a washing machine, dishwasher, and everything needed to settle in from the day you arrive.

One of the property’s key advantages is its location. The nearby autobahn can be reached in around five minutes, providing quick access to all parts of Munich and the surrounding region, while the neighbourhood itself remains quiet and residential. A bus stop is just a five-minute walk away, offering convenient public transport connections to the city. Everyday shopping is only a five-minute drive away, and the Olympia Shopping Centre, one of Munich’s largest shopping centres, can be reached in approximately ten minutes by car.

Whether you’re relocating to Munich, working on a temporary assignment, or simply looking for a furnished home for an extended stay, you’ll enjoy the space, comfort and convenience of a private townhouse with excellent transport links in a peaceful residential setting.
